attack_techniques: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Cloud Logs (T1562.008)
attackers_goals: An attacker may change the configuration of the affected resource to remain undetected.
description: An AWS CloudWatch log group was deleted, this action permanently deletes all the archives associated with this group.
investigative_actions: Check why the identity deleted the log group. Check what resources were affected by this change.
name: AWS CloudWatch log group deletion
